title: An enabled member creates a named bot in the workspace
description:
## Found on `chatticus-b88c0a`

`EnabledWorkspace` lists bots and can send a message. It never calls `POST /bots`. The hand run minted **Ping** via kernel `create_bot` so F-safe could run.

## Done when

An enabled member creates a named bot from the workspace UI without the members CLI or a kernel snippet. Behavior in Gherkin first.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Next after `070cb4`. Composer 2.5 planning. Worktree to be named `/tmp/chatticus-7622fd-create-bot` on `feat/7622fd-create-bot-ui`. Implementation not authorized until the plan is reviewed. Gherkin first: enabled member creates a named bot from the workspace UI (`POST /bots` already exists). Do not mix grants (`5336ff`) unless create-without-a-name-control cannot ship without it.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan reviewed and **authorized** with holes closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-7622fd-create-bot` on `feat/7622fd-create-bot-ui` (HEAD `dca2901`, not the primary clone).

**Closed on authorize:**
1. One path: `CreateBotPanel` → `POST /bots` → `listBots` refresh. No kernel/CLI leftover in the product UI.
2. Empty name: strip; UI blocks empty submit; HTTP 400. No dual validators.
3. Do not implement grants (`5336ff`). A created bot may still be grantless; that is the next card.
4. Wiki runbook step 5 is `pm:` after merge, not in the product PR.
5. After merge I will create a bot from the enabled workspace on development myself (Google SPA may need a labeled HTTP deviation).

Tear the worktree down only after the manager closes the issue.
